name: com.kidzdev.unity.popup
description: Modal dialogs for Unity you await for a typed result — ShowAsync<TResult>(), stacked popups, async transitions, and a per-popup loader split (Resources / Direct / Addressables). UniTask-only, Addressables stays optional, zero singleton coupling.

samples.description: A scene wiring confirm/alert dialogs, a stacked warning over a confirm, and the same layer mixing Resources- and Direct-loaded popups.
An IPopupLoader backed by Unity Addressables (ref-counted handle + in-flight de-dup). Import only if you load popups via Addressables.
